description: This source file contains backend API implementations for the COSA Data Model related to MTA (Multi-Tenant Access) configurations, DHCPV6 info, and various table entries like LineTable in a broadband gateway environment.

classes.name: COSA_MTA_DHCPv6_INFO
classes.description: Data structure holding DHCPv6 configuration info, including IP addresses, prefixes, hostnames, and DNS info.

classes.name: COSA_MTA_DHCP_INFO
classes.description: Data structure holding DHCP configuration details like IP address, subnet mask, gateway, DNS addresses, and lease times.

classes.name: COSA_MTA_LINETABLE_INFO
classes.description: Represents a single entry in the line table with parameters such as LineNumber, Status, CAPort, and associated diagnostics info.

classes.name: PCOSA_DATAMODEL_MTA
classes.description: Main data model context for the MTA component, holding configurations, table entries, logs, and other relevant data.

classes.name: PCOSA_MTA_PKTC
classes.description: Structure storing packet transmission control info, including various Tos (Type of Service) parameters.

classes.name: PCOSA_DML_MTA_LOG
classes.description: Structure holding various logging configuration flags and states for MTA diagnostics.

classes.name: PCOSA_MTA_PKTC
classes.description: Structure storing packet transmission control info, including Tos parameters.

classes.name: PCOSA_MTA_HANDSETS_INFO
classes.description: Data structure representing individual DECT handset information including name, firmware, last active time, and supported TNs.

classes.name: PCOSA_DOSA_DSXLOG
classes.description: Data structure for DSX logs including Time, Description, ID, Level.

classes.name: PCOSA_DML_DECTLOG_FULL
classes.description: Extended data structure for detailed DECT log entries including EventID, EventLevel, Description, Time.

classes.name: PCOSA_DMLS_MTA_LOG
classes.description: Extended log structure for MTA logs.
